input: Find one-week specialty camps (science, history, nature, arts) run by nonprofits for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville nonprofit summer camp 2026 science arts history week

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: Summer 2026 science camps with hands-on investigations, visiting scientists and field trips.

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: Weekly 2026 studio-art camps for rising K–12; morning and afternoon sessions can combine into full days.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2026 weekly arts camps for children and teens, including dance, singing, crafts and performance.

candidates.name: RiverLink
candidates.note: French Broad RiverCamp offers week-long watershed exploration and river recreation for rising grades 3–8.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Six one-week themed sessions in 2026; ages 3–12 explore forests, gardening, animals and nature-based art.

candidates.name: Wortham Center for the Performing Arts
candidates.note: 2026 Creative Arts Camp offered with ArtSpace Charter School educators; multidisciplinary arts and performance.

candidates.name: LEAF Global Arts / Camp Grier
candidates.note: 2026 summer arts camps at 19 Eagle Street; LEAF became part of nonprofit Camp Grier in 2026.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Theatre
candidates.note: Tanglewood Summer includes one-week advanced theatre camps and additional youth theatre programs.

candidates.name: Asheville Contemporary Dance Theatre
candidates.note: Nonprofit dance company offered summer 2026 camps and intensives through its New Studio of Dance.

candidates.name: Asheville Music School
candidates.note: Monday–Friday 2026 camps for ages 4–18 in strings, rock, jazz, voice, Appalachian music and audio production.

candidates.name: Earth Path Education
candidates.note: Nature Sisters Day Camp, August 2–6, 2027, offers nature connection and creative activities for girls ages 8–11.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: Week-long COMPASS for older teens; 2026 tracks included history, herpetology, design and writing; June 20–24 announced for 2027.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College
candidates.note: Swannanoa Gathering offers week-long folk-arts programs and a children's program; summer 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: 2026 weekly Summer Adventures combines selected enrichment classes with outdoor activities for rising K–9.
